ordinance_area_text: Locust Lane Subdivision and the adjoining R-2 zoning district in Midway Acres Subdivision, more fully described in an exhibit filed with a copy of the ordinance from which this section derives in the office of the county administrator.
method: Downloaded with ArcGIS REST query (outSR=4326, paged); selected features by attribute; union in a local equal-distance plane; clipped to the Census 2023 cartographic-boundary (cb_2023_us_county_500k) polygon for the jurisdiction's FIPS (sources/geo/cb_2023_us_county_500k) rather than the heavily simplified public/data/jurisdictions.geojson outline, so land near the boundary is not cut off; simplified (Douglas-Peucker, preserve topology), snapped to 1e-5 deg, single MultiPolygon feature. Script: scratchpad scripts/proc.py. Union of (a) all tax parcels in tax-map blocks 60A-2 through 60A-7 (the platted lot strip along Locust Lane, legal descriptions 'LOCUST LANE ...' and 'MIDWAY L..'), and (b) the R-2 zoning polygon (OBJECTID 59) in block 60A-12 next to Midway Acres lots L1-L3; closing of 15 m to include the Locust Lane roadway; holes < 3000 m2 filled; tolerance 0.00002 deg.
notes: Result 0.19 km2 (~47 acres), 0.05% of the county, near Midway/US-33 west of Stanardsville around 38.24 N, -78.383 W. The ordinance's exhibit was not available, so the boundary is reconstructed from parcel legal descriptions. The lots along Locust Lane are a single numbered sequence (lots 4-53, sections 1-4); lots 13-14 and 18-53 are described 'LOCUST LANE (ADD)', while lots 4-11 and 15-17 and lettered lots A-E at the southwest end are described 'MIDWAY'. All of them were included as the Locust Lane subdivision (this may overstate it by ~10 small lots at the southwest end). The 'adjoining R-2 zoning district in Midway Acres' was taken to be the only R-2 polygon in the area: block 60A-12, which also holds 'MIDWAY ACRES L1-L3'. Today those Locust Lane lots are zoned A-1 in the parcel records. Also note exception (b)(2): discharge on private property with the owner's permission, with reasonable care to keep projectiles on the property, is not a violation.
recovered: Recovered 2026-11 from public/data/local-areas.geojson (the original source files were lost); geometry carries that layer's 30% simplification.
